critical_blockers.coverage_failure: The group has one registered assembly witness. That witness can pass on other attached geometry while these barcode components remain unsupported. residuals_and_limits: No full rebuild, render, promotion, map edit, source save or runtime test was performed by this critic. Current saved native source was scored.

The source cold-open and all native dependencies resolve in this checkout; relocation/packaged extraction, full procedural rebuild, Unity material conversion, collision, interaction state, navigation, performance and draw-call budgets remain unchecked.
Authored open mesh components may be intentional print, seam or shell surfaces; open components are not automatically failed. No global self-intersection or watertightness certification is claimed.

Evaluated zero-area polygons were found on six inherited-name Impact wall lining meshes (168 each), Supply bench top (248), and Blanket institutional tag (5); these were not found in the 156 authored/revised mesh cohort. Modifier/topology cause and runtime export effect were not exhaustively audited.

Independent small-part diagnostic examined 9 selected joined assemblies plus all 96 cabinet barcode components. It resolved most candidate separations through nearby inherited supports. It does not certify every disconnected island in the entire room.

Visual categories /90 are unscored. Only HERO_CABINET and DETAIL_SUPPLIES were opened for contextual technical pixel inspection; concealed millimetre gaps are judged from geometry, not flattering or dark camera visibility.
No prior critic reports, rubric scores, acceptance or TASK_STATE contents were read. Code was read solely for technical behavior and coverage.
